notes:
GOAT Sim Coach 0.9.215 (beta) - everything since 0.9.196

Full list, release by release: the manual's "What's new" section.

SMART
- Answers your questions again (0.9.213/0.9.214 acknowledged without answering); if an answer ever fails, SMART says so instead of going quiet.
- Checks your remembered brake bias in the pits or on the grid every session.
- "How many laps / how much time left?" answered straight from the session.
- Corner calls on time or not at all; traffic calls go ahead of coaching; finishes its sentences in a race.
- Assetto Corsa setups: SMART changes only what it names, from the setup on the car, within the car's own limits, and never says a change is saved unless it saved it.

Overlays and Dash
- iRacing Lone Qualify: radar, relative and track map show only your car.
- Corners window follows the car and keeps its rows across a new session best.
- AC/ACC spotter bars light the real side; AC brake bias, TC and ABS levels from the car's own data.
- Before the first lap, the overlay uses this session's best lap and the Dash shows dimmed placeholders.
- GOAT Dash: tidier top bar, bigger status lights, draws every screen refresh.

Highlights
- Overtakes run until the pass is done; TV angles fall back to the screen when the game capture is black; practice, qualifying and race become separate videos; a Cancel button while filming.

GOAT itself
- Code-signed by InfinityIT Limited.
- Runs lighter: no CPU core spent on overlay status checks; stays up if its window closes mid-session; the update check always finishes.
